core_meaning.short_meaning: Rich, wealthy, self-sufficient, free from want
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghani is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Rich, wealthy, self-sufficient, free from want”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghani corresponds to the Arabic form غني (Arabic root غ ن ي (gh-n-y); غَنيّ (Ghaniyy)). Its core sense is wealthy, rich, self-sufficient. Ghani is Arabic غنيّ (Ghaniyy) 'rich, wealthy, self-sufficient, free from want' — also one of the divine names (al-Ghaniyy). The source gloss 'handsome, generous' is wrong for this word and has been replaced.
